# DevRoast

> The AI-powered GitHub Developer Report Card.

DevRoast is a dynamic Proof-of-Work (PoW) generator and scoring engine for software engineers. It fetches real-time public repository data from the GitHub REST API and calculates a weighted "Dev Score".

## Core Scoring Mechanics
The Dev Score (out of 100) is calculated based on four primary vectors:
- **Impact (40%)**: Total stars and forks across public repositories.
- **Activity (30%)**: Commit frequency and recency of updates.
- **Versatility (15%)**: Number of unique programming languages utilized.
- **Clout (15%)**: Follower-to-following ratio and sheer follower volume.

## AI Roast Generation
After calculation, DevRoast uses the Groq API (Llama 3) to generate a customized, humorous "roast" based on the developer's exact statistics. The application also maintains a global leaderboard of scanned profiles.

## Important Links
- Home: https://devroast.vercel.app
- Leaderboard: https://devroast.vercel.app/leaderboard
- Privacy Policy: https://devroast.vercel.app/privacy

## Architecture & Tech Stack
- **Data Integration**: Real-time GitHub REST API fetching.
- **Engine**: Pure scoring engine logic for mathematical sub-score calculation.
- **Database**: Caching and leaderboard tracking via MongoDB Atlas.
- **LLM**: Generative AI roasts via Groq.
- **Frontend/Framework**: Built with Next.js 15 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and @chenglou/pretext for zero-layout-shift UI text streaming.
